translations.translatedText: # Wednesday 21.9.2022 (radio)
Russian army. Finland's defence minister's assessment. Corona vaccines. Sale of Uniper. Weather.
## Russian army
![Vladimir Putin at his desk](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1920,h_1080,x_0,y_104/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1010986632b005075d0c/1663762582)
Open image viewer
President Vladimir Putin has spoken about Russia's plans. Photo: Handout / AFP
Russia is strengthening its army. President Vladimir Putin spoke about the matter on Wednesday.
Putin said that conscripted Russians will be called into the army. Russia intends to call 300,000 people into the army.
Russia is strengthening its army, because Russia's war in Ukraine has gone badly. Ukraine has taken back areas that Russia seized at the start of the war.
Russia started the war in Ukraine about 7 months ago.
## Defence Minister Kaikkonen
![Antti Kaikkonen.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5265,h_2961,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1010768632ada3e11b72/1663752823)
Open image viewer
Finland's Defence Minister Antti Kaikkonen. Photo: Emmi Korhonen / Lehtikuva
Finland's Defence Minister Antti Kaikkonen says that Russia's decision to strengthen its army was not a surprise.
Kaikkonen estimates that Russia needs new soldiers. The war in Ukraine has gone badly, and many Russian soldiers have died in the war.
Kaikkonen says that training new soldiers takes a lot of time for Russia. Only later will it be seen how they affect the course of the war in Ukraine.
The situation in Finland's nearby areas is calm, Defence Minister Kaikkonen says. Finland has a long border with Russia, but there is no reason for concern.
## Corona vaccines

![A nurse holds a corona vaccine and a needle in close-up.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4020,h_2258,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-100218563109b7fe3a24/1668858659)
Open image viewer
Corona vaccines prevent serious corona disease. Photo: Petri Niemi / Yle
New corona vaccines are arriving in Finland this week. They also work well against the omicron variant of the coronavirus.
New corona vaccines will be given in the autumn to people over 65 and to everyone who belongs to risk groups. Risk groups include people who have, for example, a serious illness.
Healthy working-age people do not need a new corona vaccine if they have already been vaccinated 3 times.
## Sale of Uniper
![Nord Stream gas pipes in Lubmin, Germany.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6503,h_3644,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-1006566631f138306017/1664294120)
Open image viewer
Uniper imports gas to Germany. Photo: Hannibal Hanschke / EPA
The situation of the energy company Uniper is becoming clearer. The German state is buying Fortum's stake in Uniper.
Fortum will also get back the 8 billion euros with which it has helped Uniper.
The deal is important for Finland. Finland's state is Fortum's biggest owner, and Fortum has suffered from Uniper's large losses.
Uniper's losses are due to the price of gas. Imports of cheap gas from Russia have ended because of the war.
The deal is also important for Germany, because Uniper delivers gas for heating and to factories in Germany.
## The weather
![Weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12633688)
Open image viewer
The weather is dry, and in the west also sunny.
Warmer air is flowing into Finland, and the temperature rises on Thursday to between 10 and 15 degrees. The warmest is in the west.
In Northern Lapland a little rain falls, otherwise it is dry.
